metadata.title: Verified Professionals for Important Work
metadata.description: Find verified professionals for legal, property, documentation, compliance and government-service work in Indian cities.

hero.title: Right expert. Right guidance. Right outcome.
hero.copy: Bharosa Hai is a trust-driven professional services network that helps people find verified experts for legal matters, government documentation, compliance, licensing, municipal work and local consulting.

how.title: A simple path from discovery to verified help.
how.copy: The customer journey will stay calm and guided: choose a category, describe the work and connect with a professional who has already passed onboarding checks.

items.title: Choose the work type

items.title: Share the requirement
items.copy: The platform captures timeline, documents and expected outcome in plain language.

items.title: Match with verified help

items.title: Complete with confidence
items.copy: Future workflows will add status updates, support and document-safe handoffs.

verificationMatter.title: Trust is the product, not a badge added later.
verificationMatter.copy: Bharosa Hai is designed for categories where customers need confidence before they share personal details, property documents or business information.

items.title: Reduces confusion
items.copy: Profiles show service focus, city coverage, experience and required professional documents.

items.title: Improves accountability
items.copy: Every provider starts with a traceable record and an admin-reviewed status.

items.title: Protects brand trust
items.copy: The platform can grow only if the first provider network feels credible.

verification.title: A structured process before marketplace visibility.
verification.copy: Provider onboarding is deliberately more careful than a generic sign-up form. It is built for quality control from day one.
verification.imageAlt: Professional documents being reviewed on a desk

items.title: Identity review
items.copy: We ask for basic identity and contact information so every listed professional starts with a traceable profile.

items.title: Credential screening
items.copy: Profession-specific documents are reviewed before providers can represent themselves on the platform.

items.title: Profile quality check
items.copy: Experience, city coverage, languages and service focus are checked for customer clarity.

items.title: Admin decision
items.copy: Admins approve, reject or request more documents before a provider is marked ready.

visionMission.visionCopy: Build India’s most trusted network for everyday professional services where verified local expertise is easy to find.
visionMission.missionCopy: Make important work easier to start, understand, track and complete without customers feeling lost in paperwork or uncertainty.

why.title: Designed for seriousness, not noise.
items: Clean customer experience planned around trust and clarity
Local Indian service categories with practical workflows

testimonials.customerQuote: The promise is simple: I should know who I am speaking to before sharing property or business documents.
testimonials.partnerQuote: A professional profile with verification can help serious providers stand apart from casual listings.

faqPreview.title: Questions early users ask.
faqPreview.copy: The full FAQ covers provider onboarding, customer launch, verification, cities and support.

items.question: Is Bharosa Hai already open for customers?
items.answer: The public customer workflow is being prepared for verified providers. The current Tier 1 focus is provider onboarding and verification.

items.question: Who can become a provider?
items.answer: Lawyers, CAs, GST consultants, property advisors, documentation experts and local government-service specialists can apply.

items.question: Why is verification important?
items.answer: These categories involve trust, documents and personal or business decisions. Verification creates a stronger starting point for customers and partners.

items.question: Which cities are included first?
items.answer: The launch is focused on Mathura, Vrindavan and nearby districts before expanding to more Indian cities.

cta.title: Join the founding provider network.
cta.copy: Apply during launch if you want to be part of a trusted professional network built for long-term quality.
